adjudication.rationale: The migration `CreateEmbeddableHosts` inserts old `site_settings.embeddable_hosts` values via raw SQL (`INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`) without going through the `EmbeddableHost` model, so its `before_validation` normalization (stripping `http(s)://` and paths) never runs. The new authorization path `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` parses the request URL and then matches with `where("lower(host) = ?", host)`, which only matches bare hostnames. Any migrated rows containing `http://...` or `/path` (explicitly supported by the removed `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?` code) will not match and will cause `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?` to return false, leading to `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` raising `InvalidAccess` (403).
